retrievalProfile.description: A high-energy 1980s rock aesthetic featuring custom lightning-bolt lettering and airbrushed objects against a vibrant electric blue field.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central, oversized yellow title with lightning bolt terminals dominates an electric blue background, flanked by realistic airbrushed elements like audio cables and a beer bottle emitting foam.
coreVisualRelationships: The title's tail transforms into a lightning bolt striking a bottle
Audio cables frame the bottom-left corner to create diagonal tension
A dense block of artist names at the top provides a textured header
The beer bottle and cap anchor the bottom-right composition
coreInvariants: Lightning bolt terminals on primary display text

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Massive central title occupying the middle third of the frame.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The beer bottle in the bottom right acts as the physical source of the title's energy.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the top artist list, drop to the large title, follow the lightning bolt to the bottle, and sweep back up via the audio cables.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Open electric blue space around the central title to emphasize its scale.

colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High saturation throughout with high-value highlights on airbrushed surfaces.

letterConstructionRules: Terminals must end in sharp lightning bolt points
Thick black drop shadow for 3D pop
Interconnected lowercase letters with sharp, jagged transitions
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'R' has a lightning bolt top serif
The 'e' extends into a long, jagged lightning bolt tail
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Aggressive custom display type paired with a functional, blocky sans-serif for secondary information.

candidateDirections.reason: Captures the aggressive 80s brush script feel
Matches the high-energy, slightly warped display style

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate an electric blue background with an airbrushed beer bottle in the bottom right emitting white foam, and thick audio cables entering from the bottom left. Leave the center and top clear.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add the main title in a custom yellow lightning-bolt script in the center. Add a block of all-caps yellow sans-serif text at the top, separated by small lightning bolt icons.

verificationChecks: Does the main title have lightning bolt ends?
Is the background a vibrant electric blue?
Are the secondary texts in all-caps yellow?
Is there a beer bottle and audio cable present?

mustRedesign: Generic fonts into lightning-bolt custom lettering
Standard separators into lightning bolt icons
postGenerationChecks: Check for sharp lightning bolt terminals on the main title
Verify the yellow-to-orange gradient on the lettering
Ensure the background is a saturated electric blue
Confirm the presence of airbrushed depth on the bottle and cables
recipe.reuseFormula: Combine [Electric Blue Background] + [Lightning Bolt Display Type] + [Airbrushed Object Framing] + [All-Caps Block Header].
